title: Depth dial completed: corrected estimates, variance and actual skill owners
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: full proposal review; later corrections and accepted direction separated; useful skill-template delta folded into SLC120
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual full review covers all845 original lines: Rounds1–19, A1–A6 and later sub-arcs, F1–F28, S1–S8, Q-W1–Q-W34, IB1–IB16 and all correction/status tables. This is text/owner reconciliation, not new inspection of private packs, source paragraphs, branch code, screenshots or replay. Current USER_VISION daily-life/calibration/variance sections, PROJECT, ACR1–ACR14, SLC37/SLC42/SLC120 and the existing later mechanism/workflow reconciliation qualify this dated proposal. Saving ideas does not adopt its slot framework, depth picks, model allocations or schedules.

F2: Rounds3–5 correct daily-life overreach: the small dirty-bundle probe did not establish missing job/wage/bakery systems, and idle time without automatic events is not a defect by itself. Current direction leaves daily-life granularity adjustable and wage/rent for actual need. AD48 retains mechanisms leading their consuming book windows; it does not adopt the novelty rule, loop-count campaign metric or generic Proto23 panel target. Round1 stage/hour rates are superseded by Round7's attributed sweep measurements; medium/bar rates, cuts afterch84 and later-volume picks remain estimates. A measured25-act timeout is no universal stage cap, and repeated explicit-checkpoint hops are not a fresh uninterrupted current journey. Current PROJECT already reaches KJ3AE, so the old A2-start queue and no-runtime/all-queued tables are not live status.

F3: F16's all-new-bar-state claim is narrowed by F18/F20 and the read-only slot check: existing progress/place-act/keyed-draw/canon-pull seams were reported, while evaluator/seed-storage and threshold/anchor behavior retained named gaps. F20 supersedes Round10's same-details-every-canon-run reading: a key selects a variation; circumstances set the dial; source-stated figures remain anchored under AD49. USER_VISION already records Q-W10's actual direction, so its repeated pending wording is historical. AD33 tiers, root-seed policy, native-readiness and the full slot design are not adopted by recording that direction. ACR1–ACR14 now own activity compression principles. In particular ACR5 distinguishes effort from known coverage/success; an investigation bar must not promise a hidden solution. ACR7/8/9/11 retain phase settlement, actual clocks, knowledge/draw history and committed-save terms. This introduces no universal activity engine or research/build dispatch.

F4: Rounds12–15 retire carry-with-decay and the one-progress-track-per-skill idea. SLC37/SLC42 already distinguish native XP skills and simulation powers/sources; a read-only inspector can show both without merging their growth owners. Shared pool, acquired faculty, active condition, technique mastery, knowledge and current expression are different quantities. SLC119/SLC120 own proposed catalogue/timeline work; anchor band and free variables are useful columns, with no stated bound recorded as unknown rather than an invented level. The SLC120 owner row now incorporates that authorized column specification and store identity; its old uncommitted-row/hunk blockage is historical. No timeline/source paragraph is qualified by adding the schema. Greater ability need not merely lower prices or forbid a source-supported stat/body change under AD38; lack of a stated bonus is not proof no such effect can ever exist.

F5: Rounds16–19 preserve the inspector edit's dated source/focused-test/full-suite/architecture evidence separately from build/play. Their Spirit Vision analysis distinguishes BE authored knowledge/fact acts, Tingen abilities, condition switch/exhaustion and actual pool consumption. F26's KJ3Z0/3 fallback collision is a real proposed integration check, not proof native metered reads already ran. B554's later KJ3Z review and current backlog qualify the old787 ceiling as an engine purse with unresolved provenance, not a proven total-wealth cap. Round19 corrects its own branch-search miss; current backlog now records B2/B3 merged, with B3 below floor and no new native/browser claim. B4/B5/R1 and KJ3AA later bounded native divination evidence does not prove Spirit Vision. Constant drain, switch-start cost, deliberate read, exhaustion, recovery, faculty development and observer exposure remain separate. Historical receipt source claims stay attributed, not freshly paragraph-checked. The proposed additive faculty/drain still needs an actual compatibility decision; additive shape alone does not guarantee every pending state is safe.

F6: IB1–IB16 remain preserved by original ID. Retain on-demand NPC/source-band abilities, real per-actor means, costs and readers; no automatic symmetry requires identical capacity for materially different actors. The clue example is illustrative: an observation of a seeded fact does not certify divination, false beliefs, partial evidence or all-world perception; those retain actual mechanism and observer owners. Knowing a result is not ownership or universal truth. GR freeze-on-reveal preserves established generated facts and attributed history, without forcing every unseen future ability into a permanently frozen value. Q-W answers already recorded or superseded are not renewed questions; genuinely unresolved depth/cost/consumer choices reopen only for a selected current slice. Useful farming, routines, cases, encounters and future advancement palettes survive without mandatory chores or source expansion. No gameplay, source reading/acquisition, worker/message, migration, deletion, commit or push occurred.
reviews.evidence: Read original1–845 in untruncated chunks1–100,101–225,226–350,351–500,501–625,626–750,751–845; current named owner sections read. No linked runtime or novel-source verification.
reviews.reopen: Selected current arc or skill intake can use the preserved bank, current activity rules and SLC120; outstanding implementation and source questions require their actual owner/proof.

folds.heading: ## Depth and skill timeline reconciliation B566
folds.body: The full [depth-dial proposal review](gm/dispatch/refinement-audits-2026-10-31/DEPTH_DIAL_PROPOSAL.md#content-reconciliation-b566-depth-variance-and-skill-owner-corrections) maps Rounds12–19 back to SLC37/SLC42/SLC119/SLC120. Its Round16 records authorization for the SLC120 columns but could not then edit an uncommitted row. That old shared-tree blockage is not a current requirement to wait for a commit. The existing SLC120 row now names the actual skill store, source-checked anchor band (or no bound stated) and unstated free variables beside its existing evidence/consumer columns. This is an authorized template clarification, not acceptance or completion of the timeline or a new source read. Native XP skills and simulation powers/sources retain separate owners. The depth receipt's later inspector tests, B3 conditions and proposed faculty/drain remain separately scoped historical evidence; no new runtime/visual/persistence proof is claimed.
